card.name: "Should know" in patient information headings
card.fires_on: The word "should" (or "I") in "What is the most important information I should know about [drug]" headings. It also fires on "to" or "should" after "steps" or "factors" in similar advisory phrases.

modes.description: "should" or "I" inside the patient-leaflet question about the most important information to know about a drug.
